sourceEvidence.title: Quality Manager - Additive Manufacturing
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university in a technical or related field required
* Progressive quality experience in a manufacturing environment, including experience leading or supervising Quality Engineering, inspection, NDT, or related quality functions
* Hands-on working knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), including day-to-day execution and maintenance of QMS processes and documentation
* Demonstrated experience actively participating in AS9100, NADCAP, customer, and/or internal audits, including preparation of objective evidence and corrective action follow-up; experience with NDT-related NADCAP requirements strongly preferred
* Experience implementing and maintaining NADCAP-accredited inspection processes and supporting compliance to applicable NDT and/or inspection requirements
* Working knowledge of aerospace quality planning and product acceptance tools, including APQP, PFMEA, Control Plans, AS9102 First Article Inspection, GD&T, and capability/statistical process control methods
* Hands-on experience with dimensional inspection and measurement systems, including CMM and/or 3D scanning, layout inspection, gage control, calibration, and generation of customer inspection data packages preferred
* Demonstrated ability to balance department efficiency, compliance, responsiveness, and service excellence
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communications skills including ability to listen attentively and to communicate information clearly and effectively
* Demonstrated interpersonal, collaborative, and relationship-building skills; ability to interact positively with teammates at various levels across the company and customers
